comparison.objective: Seat an add-on board onto two header-pin rows without bending pins; candidate removes one crimp terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Parallel multi-pin alignment and controlled insertion versus narrow tool insertion around one contact, tang depression, and rearward extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the board fully seated and released with no pin ever bent; candidate requires one terminal extracted while all neighbors remain retained and the housing reusable. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both demand connector precision, but multi-pin mating tests insertion and coplanarity rather than selective depinning.
